Use the keeper house wall finish on its east gable (T-2380) (#1702)

Assign the existing wall material to the pictured keeper east-end triangle while preserving native geometry and current foreign changes. The actual native 272 build and WEB, published target review in both viewports, desktop 107, carried mobile 139 and current eight-part gate qualify this bounded increment. T-2380 remains open/partial.
